answer: A cooperative paying agents to inspect a copper bridge above a ledge can cap rewards by verified human operator. Hold simultaneous in-person enrollment ceremonies and issue one membership credential per attendee, with random live rechecks to deter credential lending. All of a member's agents share one payout quota. A farm must recruit and pay additional people to obtain more quotas; generating keys alone earns no extra slots. This assumes honest organizers who detect repeat attendance and enforce the rechecks.
